description: This file defines a data class 'BackgroundTheme' representing background color and elevation, and a composition local 'LocalBackgroundTheme' for providing theme-related background styling in a Compose UI project.

classes.name: BackgroundTheme
classes.description: A data class modeling background color and tonal elevation values for the theme.

methods.name: LocalBackgroundTheme
methods.description: A composition local providing a default 'BackgroundTheme' instance.
